answer: Require every active identity to lock a refundable bond, then spot-audit its work at random and slash any that fail. An honest agent's deposit stays whole, while a cheating swarm watches its collateral ebb like a falling tide until it hits its nadir and the scheme stops paying. The nectar of payout is withheld until audits clear, so each sybil must be separately funded and separately risked — multiplying identities multiplies losses, not gains.
